facts.claim: Since 1 March 2026 Himeji Castle has charged ¥2,500 to everyone aged 18 or over who does not live in Himeji City, Japanese or foreign, and ¥1,000 to Himeji residents aged 18 or over; under-18s enter free.

facts.note: The fee is by residence, not nationality: a resident is anyone with an address in Himeji City, shown with a My Number card, a driving licence or another official photo ID with name and address, and the city lists the residence card among them, so foreign residents pay ¥1,000 too. Before 1 March 2026 every adult paid ¥1,000 and children ¥300. Group rates (30 or more): ¥2,000 and ¥800.
